Game Overview

In Pivot Strike, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the chaos of Pivot Strike by mastering a thrilling touch-to-drag mechanic. Strategize your ship's alignment for optimal fire rates and color-coded enemy destruction. Absorb enemy attacks with clever ship positioning to dominate the battlefield. Aim for high scores and unlock trophies in this fast-paced, strategic space shooter.
